name: sectionsEquivOfHasPullbacks
statement: PreZeroHypercover S) [E.HasPullbacks] (F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type*) : (E.toPreOneHypercover.multicospanIndex F).sections ≃ Subtype (Presieve.Arrows.Compatible F E.f) where toFun s

name: IsStronglySheafFor.isSheafFor_sieve_of_pullback
statement: E.IsStronglySheafFor F) (h₂ : ∀ ⦃Y : C⦄ (f : Y ⟶ X), Presieve.IsSeparatedFor F (E.sieve₀.pullback f).arrows) {S : Sieve X} (H : ∀ (i : E.I₀), Presieve.IsSheafFor F (S.pullback (E.f i)).arrows) (H' : ∀ ⦃i j : E.I₀⦄ (k : E.I₁ i j), Presieve.IsSeparatedFor F (S.pullback (E.p₁ k ≫ E.f i)).arrows) : Presieve.IsSheafFor F S.arrows
